    local career = profile and NormalizeCareer(profile.career) or nil
    if not career then
        return SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)
    end
    local career_key = string.lower(career)
    if career_key == "control" then
        local best = nil
        local best_dist = nil
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
            if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() and IsBossUnit(enemy) then
                local dist = (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D()
                if not best or dist < best_dist then
                    best = enemy
                    best_dist = dist
                end
            end
        end
        if best then
            return best
        end
        return SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)
    end
    if career_key == "warrior" then
        local best = nil
        local best_hp = nil
        local best_dist = nil
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
            if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
                local hp = enemy:GetHealth()
                local dist = (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D()
                if not best or hp < best_hp or (hp == best_hp and dist < best_dist) then
                    best = enemy
                    best_hp = hp
                    best_dist = dist
                end
            end
        end
        return best or enemies[1]
    end
    if career_key == "ranged" then
        local best = nil
        local best_hp = nil
        local best_dist = nil
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
            if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
                local hp = enemy:GetHealth()
                local dist = (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D()
                if not best or hp > best_hp or (hp == best_hp and dist < best_dist) then
                    best = enemy
                    best_hp = hp
                    best_dist = dist
                end
            end
        end
        return best or enemies[1]
    end
    return SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)
end

local function ComputeCareerDamageBonus(profile, enemy, origin)
    if not profile or not enemy or enemy:IsNull() then
        return 0, nil, 0
    end
    local career = NormalizeCareer(profile.career)
    if not career then
        return 0, nil, 0
    end
    local cfg = GetCareerConfigTable(career)
    local dist = origin and (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D() or 0
    local is_boss = IsBossUnit(enemy) and 1 or 0
    if not cfg then
        return 0, dist, is_boss
    end
    local bonus = 0
    local career_key = string.lower(career)
    if career_key == "warrior" then
        local range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_range", "BonusRange", "Range", "range" }) or 0
        local pct = ReadCareerPct(cfg, { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if range > 0 and dist <= range then
            bonus = pct
        end
    elseif career_key == "ranged" then
        local min_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_min_range", "BonusMinRange", "MinRange", "min_range" }) or 0
        local max_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_max_range", "BonusMaxRange", "MaxRange", "max_range" }) or 0
        local max_bonus = ReadCareerPct(cfg, { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if max_range > min_range and dist > min_range then
            local t = math.min(1, (dist - min_range) / (max_range - min_range))
            bonus = max_bonus * t
        elseif dist >= max_range and max_range > 0 then
            bonus = max_bonus
        end
    elseif career_key == "control" then
        local requires_boss = ReadCareerBool(cfg, { "requires_boss", "RequiresBoss", "BossOnly", "boss_only", "IsBoss", "is_boss" })
        if requires_boss == 0 then
            requires_boss = 1
        end
        if requires_boss == 1 and is_boss == 1 then
            bonus = ReadCareerPct(cfg, { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        end
    elseif career_key == "mage" then
        profile.career_crit_chance_bonus_pct = ReadCareerPct(cfg, {
            "crit_chance_bonus_pct",
            "CritChanceBonusPct",
            "CritChancePct",
            "crit_chance_pct",
        }) or 0
    end
    return bonus, dist, is_boss
end

local function SyncVisualFacing(parent, face_pos)
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then

    local list = GetVisualDummies(parent)
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return
    end
    for _, dummy in ipairs(list) do
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            local forward = nil
            if face_pos and dummy.GetAbsOrigin then
                local dir = face_pos - dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
                dir.z = 0
                if dir:Length2D() > 0.01 then
                    forward = dir:Normalized()
                end
            end
            if not forward and parent.GetForwardVector then
                forward = parent:GetForwardVector()
            end
            if forward then
                if dummy.SetForwardVector then
                    dummy:SetForwardVector(forward)
                end
                if face_pos and dummy.FaceTowards then
                    dummy:FaceTowards(face_pos)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function ResolveGesture(profile)
    if profile and profile._resolved_gesture then
        return profile._resolved_gesture
    end
    if profile and profile.is_attack then
        return profile.attack_gesture or ACT_DOTA_ATTACK
    end
    local kv = profile and profile.skill_kv or nil
    if not kv then
        return nil
    end
    local anim = kv.AbilityCastAnimation
    if anim and anim ~= "" and anim ~= "ACT_INVALID" then
        local act = _G[anim]
        if act then
            if profile then
                profile._resolved_gesture = act
            end
            return act
        end
    end
    local channel = kv.AbilityChannelAnimation
    if channel and channel ~= "" and channel ~= "ACT_INVALID" then
        local act = _G[channel]
        if act then
            if profile then
                profile._resolved_gesture = act
            end
            return act
        end
    end
    if profile and profile.projectile_name then
        local act = GestureDefaults[profile.projectile_name]
        if act then
            profile._resolved_gesture = act
            return act
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function PlayVisualGesture(parent, gesture, duration, face_pos)
    if not gesture then
        return
    end
    SyncVisualFacing(parent, face_pos)
    local list = GetVisualDummies(parent)
    if (not list or #list == 0) and parent then
        -- fallback to last known list in case formation list was refreshed mid-cast
        list = parent.__shop1_visual_dummies_last
        if (not list or #list == 0) and parent.__shop1_visual_main then
            local main = parent.__shop1_visual_main
            if main and not main:IsNull() then
                list = main.__shop1_visual_dummies_last or main.__shop1_visual_dummies
            end
        end
    end
    local entries = {}
    if list and #list > 0 then
        for _, dummy in ipairs(list) do
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                table.insert(entries, string.format("%s(alive=%s,start=%s)",
                    tostring(dummy:entindex()),
                    tostring(dummy:IsAlive()),
                    tostring(dummy.StartGesture ~= nil)))
            else
                table.insert(entries, "nil_or_null")
            end
        end
    end
    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop1Dummy][Gesture] caster=%s name=%s visuals=%s last=%s main=%s list=%s gesture=%s",
    --     tostring(parent and parent:entindex() or "nil"),

    --     table.concat(entries, ","),
    --     tostring(gesture)
    -- ))
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return
    end
    for _, dummy in ipairs(list) do

            if dummy.RemoveNoDraw then
                dummy:RemoveNoDraw()
            end
            if parent and parent.GetForwardVector and dummy.SetForwardVector then
                dummy:SetForwardVector(parent:GetForwardVector())
            end
            if dummy.StartGesture then

            end
            if duration and duration > 0 and dummy.FadeGesture then
                Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
                    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                        dummy:FadeGesture(gesture)
                    end
                    return nil
                end)
            end
        end
    end

local function PrepareDummySp(self, dummy, origin)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then

    local owner = self.owner or self.parent
    if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
        dummy:SetOwner(owner)
        dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    end
    if origin and dummy.SetAbsOrigin then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(origin)
    end
    dummy.__autocast_destroying = nil
    dummy:SetIdleAcquire(false)
    dummy:SetAcquisitionRange(0)
    if dummy.RemoveNoDraw then
        dummy:RemoveNoDraw()
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_phased") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_rooted") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
    if dummy:HasModifier("modifier_dummy_autocast") then
        dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, self.ability, "modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs", {
            prevent_death = 1,
        })
    end
    return dummy
end

local function AcquireDummySp(self, origin)
    for i = #DummySpPool, 1, -1 do
        local dummy = DummySpPool[i]
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            table.remove(DummySpPool, i)
        end
    end

    for _, dummy in ipairs(DummySpPool) do
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() and dummy:IsAlive() and not IsUnitBusy(dummy) then
            return PrepareDummySp(self, dummy, origin)
        end
    end

    local owner = self.owner or self.parent
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    local dummy = CreateUnitByName(
        DUMMY_SP_UNIT_NAME,
        origin or owner:GetAbsOrigin(),
        false,
        owner,
        owner,
        owner:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not dummy then
        return nil
    end

    table.insert(DummySpPool, dummy)
    return PrepareDummySp(self, dummy, origin)
end

    return ability

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnProjectileThink(profile)

    if self.is_paused then
        return 0.1
    end
    if self.parent and self.parent.__autocast_destroying then
        return 0.1
    end
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    if not profile then
        return 0.1
    end

    profile.career_damage_bonus_pct = 0
    profile.career_damage_bonus_dist = nil
    profile.career_damage_bonus_is_boss = 0
    profile.career_damage_bonus_target = nil

    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    if (not profile.is_attack and not profile.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.next_cast_time and profile.next_cast_time > now then
        return math.max(0.05, profile.next_cast_time - now)
    end

    if HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now) then
        return 0.05
    end

    local clone_active = self:IsCloneActive()
    local clone_available = clone_active and not IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit)
    local clone_busy = (self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() and IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit)) or false
    if clone_active and clone_busy then
        DebugClone("[CloneBusy] use base", profile.projectile_name, GameRules:GetGameTime())
    end

    local use_clone = (not clone_busy) and (clone_available or profile.dummy_mode == "clone")

        if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
            return 0.1
        end
        if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
            self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, self.owner, self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
        end
        local caster = self.parent
        local use_dummy_sp = false
        if not use_clone and (force_dummy_sp or IsUnitBusy(self.parent)) then
            local origin = ResolveDummySpOrigin(self, force_dummy_sp)
            caster = AcquireDummySp(self, origin) or self.parent
            use_dummy_sp = (caster ~= self.parent)
        end
        local gesture = ResolveGesture(profile) or ACT_DOTA_CAST_ABILITY_1
        if use_clone then
            PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6,
                self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
            caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, self.owner, self.owner:GetAbsOrigin(), interval) or self.parent
            LogDummyCast(caster, profile, "Self", gesture)
        else
            PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6,
                self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
            LogDummyCast(caster, profile, "Self", gesture)
            local cast_ability = profile.skill
        if use_dummy_sp then
            cast_ability = EnsureDummyAbility(profile, caster)
        end
        if not cast_ability then
            return 0.1
        end
        if caster.FaceTowards then
            caster:FaceTowards(self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = cast_ability:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
            if use_dummy_sp and profile.skill and profile.skill.StartCooldown then
                local level = math.max(profile.skill:GetLevel(), 1)
                local cooldown = profile.skill:GetCooldown(level) or 0

                    profile.skill:StartCooldown(cooldown)
                end
            end
        end
        ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, self.owner, self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
        return interval
    end

    local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
    if profile.dummy_mode ~= "clone" and clone_available and self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        origin = self.clone_unit:GetAbsOrigin()
    end
    local range = self:GetSearchRange(profile)

    local enemy = nil
    local pos = nil

    if profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target" or profile.behavior == "NoTarget" or profile.is_attack then

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function GetCastRange(ability, caster)
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return 0
    end
    if ability.GetCastRange then
        local range = ability:GetCastRange(caster:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
        if range and range > 0 then
            return range
        end
    end
    return ParseAbilityCastRange(ability:GetAbilityKeyValues())
end

    if not caster or caster:IsNull() or range <= 0 then

    end
    return FindUnitsInRadius(

        nil,
        range,

            spirit_count = fire_spirits:GetSpecialValueFor("spirit_count") or 0
        end

            return false
        end

        local launch = EnsureAbility(caster, "phoenix_launch_fire_spirit", fire_spirits:GetLevel())
        if not launch then
            return false
        end

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.05, function()
            if caster:IsNull() then
                return
            end
            local range = GetCastRange(launch, caster)
            if range <= 0 then
                return
            end

            local enemies = BuildTargets(caster, range)
            if #enemies == 0 then
                return
            end

            for i = 1, spirit_count do
                local target = enemies[i]
                if not target then
                    target = enemies[((i - 1) % #enemies) + 1]
                end
                if target and not target:IsNull() then

                        OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,

        local duration = 0

        end
        if duration <= 0 then
            duration = 2.0
        end

        Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
            if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
                return nil
            end
            local current = context.special_state and context.special_state.phoenix
            if not current or current.icarus_token ~= token then
                return nil
            end

            caster:SetOrigin(origin)
            caster:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

            -- FindClearSpaceForUnit(caster, origin, true)
            caster:AddNewModifier(caster, nil, ROOTED_MODIFIER, {})
            return nil
        end)

        return true
    end

    return false
end

function PhoenixHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= "phoenix_icarus_dive" then

    local state = EnsureState(context)

    SaveOrigin(state, context.parent)

    if context.parent:HasModifier(ROOTED_MODIFIER) then
        context.parent:RemoveModifierByName(ROOTED_MODIFIER)
    end

    return true
end

return PhoenixHandler

    if not state or not name then

local autocast_common = require("projectiles.autocast_common")
local autocast_item_config = require("projectiles.autocast_item_config")

local DEFAULT_REVEAL_DELAY = 0.05

local function NormalizeCareer(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" or s == "none" then
        return nil
    end
    return s
end

local function GetSafeTeamNumber(unit)
    local team = DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    if unit and unit.GetTeamNumber then
        team = unit:GetTeamNumber()
    end
    if not team or team < DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS or team > DOTA_TEAM_CUSTOM_8 then
        team = DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    end
    return team
end

local DummyPool = {}

local function GetRightVector(forward)
    if not forward then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    local right = Vector(forward.y, -forward.x, 0)
    if right:Length2D() < 0.01 then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    return right:Normalized()
end

local function GetHullRadiusSafe(unit)
    if unit and unit.GetHullRadius then
        local r = unit:GetHullRadius()
        if r and r > 0 then
            return r
        end
    end
    return 24
end

local function GetFormationOffset(unit)
    local name = unit and unit.GetUnitName and unit:GetUnitName() or nil
    local kv = name and UnitsKV and UnitsKV[name] or nil
    local offset = kv and tonumber(kv.Offset) or 0

    if not offset then
        return 0
    end
    return offset
end

local function SetUnselectable(unit, enable)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if enable then
        if not unit:HasModifier("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable") then
            unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable", {})
        end
    else
        unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable")
    end
end

local function TakeDummyFromPool(name)
    local pool = DummyPool[name]
    if not pool then
        return nil
    end
    while #pool > 0 do
        local dummy = table.remove(pool)
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            return dummy
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ReturnDummyToPool(name, dummy)
    if not name or not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    DummyPool[name] = DummyPool[name] or {}
    table.insert(DummyPool[name], dummy)
end

local function PrepareDummyForPool(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
        WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
    end
    dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
    dummy:AddNoDraw()
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
    if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
        dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
    end
    if dummy.Stop then
        dummy:Stop()
    end
    dummy:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:HideAllVisuals()

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ScheduleReveal(panel_entity, should_reveal)

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent() --hero
    local ability = self:GetAbility()

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        local raw_kv_withlevel = AbilityKV[ability:GetAbilityName()]

        self.custom_level      = tonumber(ability.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1

        if effect_overrides then

            if effect_overrides.additional and #effect_overrides.additional > 0 then

                for _, entry in ipairs(effect_overrides.additional) do

            end
        end
        config.effects = effects
        config.additional_effects = additional_effects
        for key, value in pairs(config) do

        self:CreateDummy(parent, ability)

end

local function ApplyHeroPassive(parent, name, level, label)
    if not name or not parent then

    if label then

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)
    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "none" then

        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel) > 0 then
            self.skill_level = raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel
        end

            team
        )
        if v then
            v:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                v:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end

            if v.SetAttackCapability then
                v:SetAttackCapability(DOTA_UNIT_CAP_NO_ATTACK)
            end
            if v.SetAttackAcquisitionRange then
                v:SetAttackAcquisitionRange(0)
            end

            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not v:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end
            SetUnselectable(v, true)
            v:AddNoDraw()
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s offset=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(offset)))
            local selectable = (v.IsUnselectable and not v:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            table.insert(self.visual_dummies, v)
        else
            break
        end
    end

    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies
    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies_last = self.visual_dummies
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_radius)
    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    if count <= 1 then
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
            self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = nil
        end
        return
    end

    if not self.selection_proxy or self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        local owner = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetOwner() or nil
        local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
        local name = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
        local proxy = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            center_pos or Vector(0, 0, 0),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if proxy then
            proxy:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                proxy:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not proxy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end

            proxy:AddNoDraw()

            SetUnselectable(proxy, false)
            local selectable = (proxy.IsUnselectable and not proxy:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][proxy] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(proxy:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            proxy.__shop1_proxy_dummy = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetEntityIndex() or nil
            self.selection_proxy = proxy
            if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
                self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = proxy:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end

    if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        if center_pos then
            self.selection_proxy:SetAbsOrigin(center_pos)
        end
        if max_radius and self.selection_proxy.SetHullRadius then
            self.selection_proxy:SetHullRadius(max_radius)
        end
        if GoodForward then
            self.selection_proxy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:UpdateFormationAtPos(center_pos)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if not center_pos then
        return nil
    end

    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    self:EnsureVisualDummies(count)

    local forward = GoodForward or self.dummy:GetForwardVector() or Vector(0, 1, 0)
    local right = GetRightVector(forward)
    local base_r = GetHullRadiusSafe(self.dummy)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)
    local r = base_r + offset
    local s = r * 2
    local h = s * 0.8660254

    local positions = {}
    if count == 1 then
        positions[1] = center_pos
    elseif count == 2 then
        positions[1] = center_pos - right * r
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * r
    elseif count == 3 then
        positions[1] = center_pos + forward * (2 * h / 3)
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * (-s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
        positions[3] = center_pos + right * (s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
    end

    if positions[1] then
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(positions[1])
    end
    if self.visual_dummies then
        for i, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            local pos = positions[i + 1]
            if v and not v:IsNull() and pos then
                v:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
                if v.SetForwardVector then
                    v:SetForwardVector(forward)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if count > 1 then
        local max_dist = 0
        for _, pos in ipairs(positions) do
            local dist = (pos - center_pos):Length2D()
            if dist > max_dist then
                max_dist = dist
            end
        end
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_dist + r)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, true)
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        self:DeleteWorldPanel()
    else
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(nil, nil)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        self:DeleteWorldPanel()
    end
    local main_pos = positions[1]
    local should_reveal = main_pos and main_pos:Length2D() < 9000
    local panel_entity = (count > 1) and self.selection_proxy or self.dummy
    self:ScheduleReveal(panel_entity, should_reveal)
    return main_pos
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    local dummy_name = "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy" .. "_" .. self.hero_name .. "_" .. self.lvl

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(parent)
    self.is_revealed = false
    local pooled = TakeDummyFromPool(dummy_name)
    if pooled then
        self.dummy = pooled
        self.dummy.__autocast_destroying = nil
        self.dummy:AddNoDraw()
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_invulnerable")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_no_healthbar")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
        self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    else
        self.dummy = CreateUnitByName(
            dummy_name,
            Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
            false,
            parent,
            parent,
            team
        )
        if self.dummy then
            self.dummy:AddNoDraw()
        end
    end

    if not self.dummy then
        return
    end

    self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
    self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    self.dummy:SetIdleAcquire(false)
    self.dummy:SetAcquisitionRange(0)
    local dummy_level = Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(tonumber(self.lvl)) or 1

    if dummy_level > 1 then
        dummy_level = dummy_level - 1
        self.dummy:CreatureLevelUp(dummy_level)
    end

    if self.pid and self.slot then
        Shop1Managers[self.pid].Slots[self.slot].Dummy = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()
        local pos = Shop1Managers[self.pid] and Shop1Managers[self.pid]:GetGoodPointPos(self.slot)
        if not pos then
            local point = EntIndexToHScript(self.slot)
            if point then
                pos = point:GetOrigin()
            end
        end
        if pos then
            self.dummy:SetOrigin(pos)
        end
    end

    self.dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

    self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(self.dummy)

    -- self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）
    if not self.dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end

    -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
    if self.dummy then
        -- Avoid passing tables through modifier KV (causes HSCRIPT argument unsupported).
        self.dummy.__autocast_additional_projectiles = self.extra_projectiles
        self.dummy.__autocast_additional_passives = self.additional_passives
        self.dummy.__autocast_effects = self.effects
        self.dummy.__autocast_additional_effects = self.additional_effects
    end
    local modifier_kv = {
        hero_name                    = self.hero_name,
        dummy_level                  = self.dummy:GetLevel(),
        projectile_name              = self.projectile_name,
        projectile_level             = self.projectile_level,
        projectile_interval          = self.projectile_interval,
        projectile_range             = self.projectile_range,
        projectile_base_damage       = self.projectile_base_damage,
        projectile_damage_scale      = self.projectile_damage_scale,
        heal_percent                 = self.heal_percent,
        pure_percent                 = self.pure_percent,
        projectile_dummy_mode        = self.projectile_dummy_mode,

        projectile_sp                = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_sp_level          = self.projectile_sp_level,
        projectile_sp_interval       = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_sp_range          = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_sp_base_damage    = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_damage_scale   = self.projectile_sp_damage_scale,
        projectile_sp_purePercent    = self.projectile_sp_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_dummy_mode     = self.projectile_sp_dummy_mode,

        projectile_sp_2              = self.projectile_sp_2,
        projectile_sp_2_level        = self.projectile_sp_2_level,
        projectile_sp_2_interval     = self.projectile_sp_2_interval,
        projectile_sp_2_range        = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
        projectile_sp_2_base_damage  = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_2_damage_scale = self.projectile_sp_2_damage_scale,
        projectile_sp_2_purePercent  = self.projectile_sp_2_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode   = self.projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode,

        passive_name                 = self.passive_name,
        passive_level                = self.passive_level,

        passive_sp                   = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level             = self.passive_sp_level,

        passive_sp_2                 = self.passive_sp_2,
        passive_sp_2_level           = self.passive_sp_2_level,

        ability_sp                   = self.ability_sp,
        modifier_sp                  = self.modifier_sp,
        lifesteal_sp                 = self.lifesteal_sp,
        career                       = self.career,
    }

    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", modifier_kv)

    local base_pos = self.dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
    self:UpdateFormationAtPos(base_pos)
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())
    self:CancelRevealTimer()
    self:DeleteWorldPanel()

    local hero = self:GetParent()

    if self.hero_passive then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp_2 then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp_2)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.skill_listener then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_item_cast_listener")
        end
    end

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        local dummy = self.dummy
        self.dummy = nil
        if self.visual_dummies then
            for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
                if v and not v:IsNull() then
                    v:Destroy()
                end
            end
            self.visual_dummies = nil
        end
        dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies_last = nil
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = nil
        PrepareDummyForPool(dummy)
        ReturnDummyToPool("npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy" .. "_" .. self.hero_name .. "_" .. tostring(self.lvl), dummy)
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(entity)
    if not entity or entity:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    if not WorldPanels then
        return
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    local level = math.max(1, math.min(tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1, 6))
    local stars = string.rep("★", level)

    self.worldPanel = WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll({
        layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/shop1_dummy_level.xml",
        entity = entity,
        entityHeight = 100,
        horizontalAlign = "center",
        verticalAlign = "bottom",
        offsetY = -25,
        data = {
            stars = stars,
            level = level,
        },
    })

    if not self.worldPanel then
        print("[WorldPanel Error] CreateWorldPanelForAll returned nil")
    end
end

**Outlining autocast special handling**

I'm comparing two design options for autocasting Tiny's tree abilities by mapping hero names to special handlers and deciding whether the projectile ability triggers from toss or tree grab, aiming to reflect Dota mechanics accurately. The plan involves adding a special handler module for Tiny within the autocast_specials framework to handle the unique cast sequence.

**Analyzing Tiny abilities’ cast dependencies**

I detailed how Tiny’s tree_grab must precede toss_tree and explored complexities of queuing casts within the autocast system, including timing, profile behavior, and potential Tree creation. The analysis favors treating tree_grab as the main projectile ability and chaining toss_tree in AfterCast to ensure stable sequencing despite system limitations on cast queuing and target handling.

function modifier_dummy_autocast:InitProjectileProfile(params)
    if not params then return end
    local name = params.name
    if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then return end
    if not params.interval or params.interval <= 0 then return end

    local is_attack = (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack")
    local profile = {
        projectile_name = name,
        interval = params.interval,
        range = params.range or 0,
        base_damage = params.base_damage or 0,
        damage_scale = params.damage_scale or 1,
        pure_percent = params.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = params.lifesteal or 0,
        hit_label = hit_label,
        is_attack = is_attack,
        attack_mode = (name == "ranged_attack" and "ranged" or "melee"),
        attack_gesture = ACT_DOTA_ATTACK,
        dummy_mode = (not is_attack and params.dummy_mode) or nil,
        next_cast_time = 0,
        career = params.career,
    }

    -- print("[InitProjectileProfile]", name, params.interval, params.base_damage, params.damage_scale)

    if not profile.is_attack then
        profile.skill = self.parent:AddAbility(name)
        if profile.skill then
            profile.skill:SetLevel(1)
            if params.level and params.level > 1 then
                profile.skill:SetLevel(params.level)
            end
            profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
            profile.skill_kv = profile.skill:GetAbilityKeyValues()
            profile.behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(profile.skill_kv)
            profile.follow_facing = tostring(profile.skill_kv.AutoCastFollowFacing or "") == "1"
            profile.ability_duration = ParseAbilityDuration(profile.skill_kv)
        end
    else
        profile.behavior = "Target"
    end

    table.insert(self.projectiles, profile)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return end
    self.follow_timer_handles = self.follow_timer_handles or {}
    local id = Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        return self:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    end)
    table.insert(self.follow_timer_handles, id)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return 0.1 end
    if self.is_paused then return 0.1 end
    if not profile.follow_facing_active then return 0.1 end
    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then return 0.1 end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if profile.follow_facing_end_time and profile.follow_facing_end_time > 0 and now > profile.follow_facing_end_time then
        profile.follow_facing_active = nil
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsInAbilityPhase() and not profile.skill:IsChanneling() then
        local active = self.parent.GetCurrentActiveAbility and self.parent:GetCurrentActiveAbility() or nil
        if not active or active ~= profile.skill then
            profile.follow_facing_active = nil
            return 0.1
        end
    end

    local target = profile.follow_facing_target
    if target and not target:IsNull() then
        profile.follow_facing_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    end

    if profile.follow_facing_pos then
        self.parent:FaceTowards(profile.follow_facing_pos)
        SyncVisualFacing(self.parent, profile.follow_facing_pos)
    end
    return 0.03
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return nil end
    if not profile then return nil end
    if profile.is_attack and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Target" and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Position" and not pos then return nil end

    local clone = self:EnsureCloneUnit()

    if not clone then return nil end

    local move_clone = profile.dummy_mode == "clone"
    if move_clone then
        local final_pos = pos or (enemy and enemy:GetAbsOrigin()) or self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
        clone:SetAbsOrigin(final_pos)

payload.text:
**Analyzing target handling for tree grab**

The normal cast targets enemies when using abilities from profile.behavior, which causes tree_grab to fail since it needs to target trees; attempts to override target via PrepareCast don't affect the engine's order parameters, so a proper fix requires a custom projectile or ability explicitly supporting correct target behavior.

**Comparing tree grab casting strategies**

The best approach is option 1: use tiny_toss_tree as the main projectile and maintain the tree-grab state proactively by spawning a temporary tree and issuing tree_grab before toss; this fits the existing framework with minimal changes. Option 2, making tree_grab the main cast, fails under auto-targeting constraints and requires invasive core changes or custom scripted abilities, making it less practical within the current autocast_specials system.

payload.message:
最优方案是选 1，但要做成“预抓树 + 投掷后补树”的稳定流程。原因是 autocast_specials 只能在 `PrepareCast/AfterCast` 前后做补丁，无法改变主流程的选敌/选点与强制改目标；因此主技能必须是能正确走选敌/选点路径的 `tiny_toss_tree`，树抓只是前置条件维护。

对比两种方案

方案 1（弹幕 = `tiny_toss_tree`，特殊处理中执行 `tiny_tree_grab`）更好
- 优点：主技能行为是单位/点目标，完全符合当前自动选敌/选点逻辑，能直接命中目标并走原有施法路径。
- 可行实现：在 `PrepareCast`/`AfterCast` 中检查是否有树（`modifier_tiny_tree_grab`），若没有就生成临时树并让施法者抓树；投掷后再补抓树，保证下一次投掷可用。
- 风险与缓解：投掷时若树还没抓到会失败，所以要“提前抓”，并在 `AfterCast` 里补抓。这样主施法永远是 toss，稳定性高。

方案 2（弹幕 = `tiny_tree_grab`，特殊处理里生成树并施放 `tiny_toss_tree`）问题更大
- 核心问题：`tiny_tree_grab` 本体是树目标技能，但自动施放框架会把它当“对敌人施放”，导致必然失败。
- 要让它可用，必须改核心框架：新增“特殊处理可阻断主施法并自定义施法流程”的机制，或改 `tiny_tree_grab` 行为/写自定义技能，这已经超出“小小特殊处理”的范围。
- 复杂度/风险明显更高。

结论
- 推荐方案 1，最少改动、最贴合当前框架。
- 如果你愿意改动框架，方案 2 可以做成“完全自定义施法流程”，但这是更重的改造，不是最优。

如果你确认走方案 1，我可以继续给出具体实现点（在哪些文件新增 tiny handler、怎么维护抓树状态、创建临时树的代码路径等）。

**Confirming modifier and casting constraints**

The tree-grab modifier is confirmed as built-in "modifier_tiny_tree_grab," so HasModifier can use that string. PrepareCast can't delay or cancel casts but can issue queued orders; thus, creating and grabbing a tree before tossing must be handled via queued orders within PrepareCast despite its ignored return value.

**Designing persistent tree-grab handler**

The plan is to create a special handler for Tiny that ensures the caster always has a grabbed tree by periodically checking and grabbing one on the dummy, plus re-grabbing immediately after a toss cast. This includes adding the tree-grab ability if missing, creating temporary trees if none nearby, and managing state with timers for ongoing upkeep.

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/autocast_specials/tiny.lua
+local TinyHandler = {}
+
+local TREE_GRAB_ABILITY = "tiny_tree_grab"
+local TOSS_TREE_ABILITY = "tiny_toss_tree"
+local TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER = "modifier_tiny_tree_grab"
+
+local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
+    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
+    if not ab then
+        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
+    end
+    if ab and level and level > 0 then
+        ab:SetLevel(level)
+        ab:SetActivated(true)
+    end
+    return ab
+end
+
+local function FindNearbyTree(origin, radius)
+    if not origin or not GridNav or not GridNav.GetAllTreesAroundPoint then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local trees = GridNav:GetAllTreesAroundPoint(origin, radius or 200, false)
+    if trees and #trees > 0 then
+        return trees[1]
+    end
+    return nil
+end
+
+local function CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
+    if not origin or not CreateTempTree then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local offset = Vector(80, 0, 0)
+    if GoodForward then
+        offset = GoodForward * 80
+    end
+    local pos = origin + offset
+    return CreateTempTree(pos, 5)
+end
+
+local function GrabTree(caster, ability, tree)
+    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
+        return false
+    end
+    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
+        return false
+    end
+    if not tree or tree:IsNull() then
+        return false
+    end
+    if ability.IsCooldownReady and not ability:IsCooldownReady() then
+        return false
+    end
+    ExecuteOrderFromTable({
+        UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
+        OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
+        AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
+        TargetIndex = tree:entindex(),
+        Queue = false,
+    })
+    return true
+end
+
+local function EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level)
+    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
+        return false
+    end
+    if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
+        return true
+    end
+
+    local grab = EnsureAbility(caster, TREE_GRAB_ABILITY, level or 1)
+    if not grab then
+        return false
+    end
+
+    local origin = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
+    local tree = FindNearbyTree(origin, 200)
+    if not tree then
+        tree = CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
+    end
+    if not tree then
+        return false
+    end
+
+    return GrabTree(caster, grab, tree)
+end
+
+local function EnsureState(context)
+    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
+    context.special_state.tiny = context.special_state.tiny or {}
+    return context.special_state.tiny
+end
+
+function TinyHandler:Init(context)
+    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
+        return
+    end
+
+    local state = EnsureState(context)
+    state.token = (state.token or 0) + 1
+    local my_token = state.token
+
+    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
+        if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
+            return nil
+        end
+        if not context.special_state or not context.special_state.tiny then
+            return nil
+        end
+        if context.special_state.tiny.token ~= my_token then
+            return nil
+        end
+
+        EnsureTreeGrab(context, context.parent, context.parent:GetLevel())
+        return 0.5
+    end)
+end
+
+function TinyHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
+    if not context or not profile or profile.is_attack then
+        return false
+    end
+    if profile.projectile_name ~= TOSS_TREE_ABILITY then
+        return false
+    end
+    local level = profile.skill and profile.skill.GetLevel and profile.skill:GetLevel() or 1
+    EnsureTreeGrab(context, context.parent, level)
+    return true
+end
+
+function TinyHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
+    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
+        return false
+    end
+    if profile.projectile_name ~= TOSS_TREE_ABILITY then
+        return false
+    end
+
+    local level = profile.skill and profile.skill.GetLevel and profile.skill:GetLevel() or 1
+    Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
+        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
+            return nil
+        end
+        EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level)
+        return nil
+    end)
+
+    return true
+end
+
+return TinyHandler
*** End Patch

@@
 local TREE_GRAB_ABILITY = "tiny_tree_grab"
 local TOSS_TREE_ABILITY = "tiny_toss_tree"
 local TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER = "modifier_tiny_tree_grab"
+local FAR_TREE_COUNT = 6
+local FAR_TREE_RADIUS = 900
+local FAR_TREE_DURATION = 8
 
 local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
@@
     return ab
 end
 
+local function TryApplyTreeGrabModifier(caster, ability)
+    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
+        return false
+    end
+    if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
+        return true
+    end
+    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
+        return false
+    end
+    local mod = caster:AddNewModifier(caster, ability, TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER, {})
+    return mod ~= nil
+end
+
 local function FindNearbyTree(origin, radius)
     if not origin or not GridNav or not GridNav.GetAllTreesAroundPoint then
         return nil
     end
@@
     return nil
 end
 
-local function CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
+local function CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
     if not origin or not CreateTempTree then
         return nil
     end
@@
-    return CreateTempTree(pos, 5)
+    return CreateTempTree(pos, FAR_TREE_DURATION)
+end
+
+local function EnsureFarTrees(state, origin)
+    if not state or not origin or not CreateTempTree then
+        return
+    end
+    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
+    if state.far_tree_expire and state.far_tree_expire > now then
+        return
+    end
+    state.far_tree_expire = now + FAR_TREE_DURATION
+
+    local angle_step = 360 / FAR_TREE_COUNT
+    for i = 1, FAR_TREE_COUNT do
+        local angle = math.rad((i - 1) * angle_step)
+        local offset = Vector(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle), 0) * FAR_TREE_RADIUS
+        CreateTempTree(origin + offset, FAR_TREE_DURATION)
+    end
 end
 
 local function GrabTree(caster, ability, tree)
@@
 local function EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level)
     if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
         return false
     end
     if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
         return true
     end
 
     local grab = EnsureAbility(caster, TREE_GRAB_ABILITY, level or 1)
     if not grab then
         return false
     end
+    if TryApplyTreeGrabModifier(caster, grab) then
+        return true
+    end
 
     local origin = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
     local tree = FindNearbyTree(origin, 200)
     if not tree then
-        tree = CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
+        local state = EnsureState(context)
+        EnsureFarTrees(state, origin)
+        tree = FindNearbyTree(origin, FAR_TREE_RADIUS + 100)
     end
     if not tree then
+        tree = CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
+    end
+    if not tree then
         return false
     end
 
     return GrabTree(caster, grab, tree)
 end
*** End Patch

local TinyHandler = {}

local TREE_GRAB_ABILITY = "tiny_tree_grab"
local TOSS_TREE_ABILITY = "tiny_toss_tree"
local TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER = "modifier_tiny_tree_grab"
local FAR_TREE_COUNT = 6
local FAR_TREE_RADIUS = 5000
local FAR_TREE_DURATION = 8

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function EnsureState(context)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.tiny = context.special_state.tiny or {}
    return context.special_state.tiny
end

local function FindNearbyTree(origin, radius)
    if not origin or not GridNav or not GridNav.GetAllTreesAroundPoint then
        return nil
    end
    local trees = GridNav:GetAllTreesAroundPoint(origin, radius or 200, false)
    if trees and #trees > 0 then
        return trees[1]
    end
    return nil
end

local function CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
    if not origin or not CreateTempTree then
        return nil
    end
    local offset = Vector(80, 0, 0)
    if GoodForward then
        offset = GoodForward * 80
    end
    local pos = origin + offset
    return CreateTempTree(pos, FAR_TREE_DURATION)
end

local function EnsureFarTrees(state, origin)
    if not state or not origin or not CreateTempTree then
        return
    end
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if state.far_tree_expire and state.far_tree_expire > now then
        return
    end
    state.far_tree_expire = now + FAR_TREE_DURATION

    local angle_step = 360 / FAR_TREE_COUNT
    for i = 1, FAR_TREE_COUNT do
        local angle = math.rad((i - 1) * angle_step)
        local offset = Vector(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle), 0) * FAR_TREE_RADIUS
        CreateTempTree(origin + offset, FAR_TREE_DURATION)
    end
end

local function GrabTree(caster, ability, tree)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not tree or tree:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if ability.IsCooldownReady and not ability:IsCooldownReady() then
        return false
    end
    ExecuteOrderFromTable({
        UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
        OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
        AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
        TargetIndex = tree:entindex(),
        Queue = false,
    })
    return true
end

local function EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
        return true
    end

    local grab = EnsureAbility(caster, TREE_GRAB_ABILITY, level or 1)
    if not grab then
        return false
    end
    local origin = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
    local tree = FindNearbyTree(origin, 200)
    if not tree then
        local state = EnsureState(context)
        EnsureFarTrees(state, origin)
        tree = FindNearbyTree(origin, FAR_TREE_RADIUS + 100)
    end
    if not tree then
        tree = CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
    end
    if not tree then
        return false
    end

    return GrabTree(caster, grab, tree)
end

function TinyHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local state = EnsureState(context)
    state.token = (state.token or 0) + 1
    local my_token = state.token

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        if not context.special_state or not context.special_state.tiny then
            return nil
        end
        if context.special_state.tiny.token ~= my_token then
            return nil
        end

        EnsureTreeGrab(context, context.parent, context.parent:GetLevel())
        return 0.5
    end)
end

function TinyHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= TOSS_TREE_ABILITY then
        return false
    end
    local level = profile.skill and profile.skill.GetLevel and profile.skill:GetLevel() or 1
    EnsureTreeGrab(context, context.parent, level)
    return true
end

function TinyHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= TOSS_TREE_ABILITY then
        return false
    end

    local level = profile.skill and profile.skill.GetLevel and profile.skill:GetLevel() or 1
    Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level)
        return nil
    end)

    return true
end

return TinyHandler

I'm planning to modify CreateTempTreeNear or the tree position in EnsureTreeGrab to use the caster's forward vector multiplied by an offset instead of GoodForward, and apply the changes to tiny.lua.

payload.name: apply_patch
payload.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/autocast_specials/tiny.lua
@@
-local function CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
-    if not origin or not CreateTempTree then
+local function CreateTempTreeNear(origin, forward)
+    if not origin or not CreateTempTree then
         return nil
     end
-    local offset = Vector(80, 0, 0)
-    if GoodForward then
-        offset = GoodForward * 80
+    local dir = forward
+    if not dir then
+        dir = GoodForward
+    end
+    if not dir then
+        dir = Vector(1, 0, 0)
     end
-    local pos = origin + offset
+    local pos = origin + dir * 80
     return CreateTempTree(pos, FAR_TREE_DURATION)
 end
@@
-    local origin = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
+    local origin = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
+    local forward = caster.GetForwardVector and caster:GetForwardVector() or nil
     local tree = FindNearbyTree(origin, 200)

         local state = EnsureState(context)
         EnsureFarTrees(state, origin)
         tree = FindNearbyTree(origin, FAR_TREE_RADIUS + 100)
     end
     if not tree then
-        tree = CreateTempTreeNear(origin)
+        tree = CreateTempTreeNear(origin, forward)
     end
*** End Patch

**Analyzing missing tree effect**

The lack of a visible tree likely stems from immediately queuing a toss right after creating and grabbing the temporary tree, causing the toss to interrupt or consume the tree before it appears; the grab may not fully complete or the effect gets overridden due to the immediate transition.

**Identifying dummy caster hidden tree issue**

The missing tree model likely happens because the tree grab ability is cast on an invisible dummy or clone unit, making the tree attach to that invisible entity rather than the visible caster; forcing the tree grab and toss to use the visible parent unit should restore the tree's visibility.

**Analyzing tree grab invisibility**

The tree grab ability might be invisible because it's attached to a dummy without the proper model or wearables to show the tree visually, or because the created tree entity is too close or not valid for display despite the ability not being hidden; the code and ability data setup suggests it should show, so the missing visual likely stems from dummy or entity placement issues.

**Explaining missing tree visuals after cast**

The tree likely doesn’t appear because the grab order targets a freshly created temp tree and is executed immediately in the same frame, causing the engine to miss applying the grab modifier; additionally, casting the ability from an invisible dummy means the tree is attached there and remains unseen. The current code also always returns handled even if tree creation or grab fails, skipping default behavior, so a delay before casting and ensuring the order targets a visible caster would resolve this.

原因主要有两种，当前代码里都可能触发：

1) `tiny_tree_grab` 实际是给 **施法者**挂 `modifier_tiny_tree_grab`，但你现在可能在用 `dummy_sp/clone` 施法，树就挂在“不可见/隐藏”的单位上，所以你看到的模型手里没有树。  
2) 现在是 **CreateTempTree 后同一帧立刻下达 GrabTree**，树对象可能还没完全注册，导致施法失败但你又跳过了默认流程。并且 `TakeoverCast` 里 **不看 `EnsureTreeGrab` 返回值**，即使抓树失败也会返回 `handled=true`，所以默认施法被拦掉，结果就是“没有树”。

对应代码位置
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/autocast_specials/tiny.lua`：`TakeoverCast`、`EnsureTreeGrab`  
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua`：`use_dummy_sp` 可能导致 caster 不是可见单位

2) 给树创建后延迟 0.03s 再 GrabTree，确保树实体已注册。  
3) 如果一定要看见树：Tiny 的 grab/toss 强制用 `context.parent`（可见 dummy），不要走 `dummy_sp`。

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then

        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

    context.special_state.tiny = context.special_state.tiny or {}
    return context.special_state.tiny
end

    if not origin or not CreateTempTree then
        return nil
    end
    local dir = forward
    if not dir then
        dir = GoodForward
    end
    if not dir then
        dir = Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end

    return CreateTempTree(pos, FAR_TREE_DURATION)

    end

        AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
        TargetIndex = tree:entindex(),
        Queue = false,

end

        return false
    end
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if ability.SetHidden then

            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = true,

    if pos then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            Position = pos,
            Queue = true,

    end
    return false

    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then

    if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then

    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then

    local caster = context and context.parent or nil

    local level = ability.GetLevel and ability:GetLevel() or 1
    EnsureAbility(caster, TREE_GRAB_ABILITY, level)
end

function TinyHandler:TakeoverCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster, ability, order_type)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= TOSS_TREE_ABILITY then
        return false
    end
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then

    EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level, enemy, pos, ability or profile.skill)
    return true, profile.interval or 0.5
end

你说得对，按现在的实际流程（不走 dummy_sp、不用 clone），问题还是出在 `tiny.lua` 的逻辑：

真实原因（基于当前代码）
1) 现在 `EnsureTreeGrab` 是“同一帧创建树 + 立刻下达抓树 + 立刻排队投掷”。  
   结果是树刚生成还未注册时就发了抓树指令，抓树可能失败；但 `TakeoverCast` 仍然返回 `handled=true`，默认投掷被拦掉。  
2) 即使抓树成功，你立刻排队投掷，树会马上被消耗，看起来“抓完就没树”。

解决方案（已改）
- 抓树改为“创建树后延迟 0.03s 再抓”，并且 **只有当 `modifier_tiny_tree_grab` 出现后才排队投掷**。  
- 如果抓树失败，投掷不会排队，避免“空投”导致看不到树。

修改文件
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/autocast_specials/tiny.lua`

关键改动摘要
- 新增 `GRAB_CAST_DELAY/GRAB_CHECK_INTERVAL/GRAB_MAX_CHECKS`
- `EnsureTreeGrab` 内部用计时器：先抓树 → 轮询确认 modifier → 成功后再 toss

如果你还希望“抓树后停留一小段时间再投”，告诉我延迟值，我可以在队列 toss 前再加一个额外 delay。

                Queue = false,
            })
        end

function M.IsUnitBusy(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local function IsFreezingFieldWithScepterActive()
        if not unit.GetCurrentActiveAbility or not unit.HasModifier then
            return false
        end

        local ability = unit:GetCurrentActiveAbility()
        if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "crystal_maiden_freezing_field" then
            return false
        end

        -- Aghanim allows full action during channel
        return unit:HasModifier("modifier_item_ultimate_scepter")
    end

    -- Channeling normally blocks everything
    if unit.IsChanneling and unit:IsChanneling() then
        if not IsFreezingFieldWithScepterActive() then
            return true
        end
    end

    -- CastPoint (ability windup) always blocks
    if unit.IsCastingAbility and unit:IsCastingAbility() then
        return true
    end

    -- AttackPoint (attack windup) blocks
    if unit.IsAttacking and unit:IsAttacking() then
        if unit.IsPerformingAttack and unit:IsPerformingAttack() then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end


function M.GetPlayerStats(owner)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() or (not owner:IsRealHero()) then
        return default_stats
    end

    local pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if not pid or pid < 0 then
        return default_stats
    end

    local stats = PlayerStats and PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid) or nil
    if not stats then
        return default_stats
    end

    return PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
end

function M.NormalizeName(value)
    if value and value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then
        return value
    end
    return nil

**Planning unit busy flag for tiny grab/toss**

I'm considering adding a __tiny_grab_busy flag on the unit during the tiny grab process to make IsUnitBusy return true until toss is queued. The flag would set at cast takeover if no grab modifier, then clear immediately after the toss order is issued. Additionally, the special autocast handler needs to be properly applied to dummy_sp and clones, possibly by initializing it when acquiring dummy_sp since currently it's only attached via the parent modifier.

**Integrating special handler with clone casting**

The special autocast handler needs to run during clone casting too, but the current clone path skips TakeoverCast. To fix this, I'll adjust SpawnCloneAndCast to call TakeoverCast with the clone after creation and use its result to control order execution and delays. This ensures dummy_sp and clone casts apply the special logic as required.

local TinyHandler = {}

local TREE_GRAB_ABILITY = "tiny_tree_grab"
local TOSS_TREE_ABILITY = "tiny_toss_tree"
local TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER = "modifier_tiny_tree_grab"
local FAR_TREE_RADIUS = 5000
local FAR_TREE_DURATION = 8
local GRAB_CAST_DELAY = 0.03
local GRAB_CHECK_INTERVAL = 0.03
local GRAB_MAX_CHECKS = 30

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function EnsureState(context)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.tiny = context.special_state.tiny or {}
    return context.special_state.tiny
end

local function CreateTempTreeNear(origin, forward)
    if not origin or not CreateTempTree then
        return nil
    end
    local dir = forward
    if not dir then
        dir = GoodForward
    end
    if not dir then
        dir = Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    local pos = origin + dir * FAR_TREE_RADIUS
    return CreateTempTree(pos, FAR_TREE_DURATION)
end

local function GrabTree(caster, ability, tree)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not tree or tree:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if ability.IsCooldownReady and not ability:IsCooldownReady() then
        return false
    end
    ExecuteOrderFromTable({
        UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
        OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET_TREE,
        AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
        TargetIndex = tree:entindex(),
        Queue = false,
    })
    return true
end

local function QueueTossTree(caster, ability, enemy, pos)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if ability.SetHidden then
        ability:SetHidden(false)
    end
    if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = true,
        })
        return true
    end
    if pos then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
            Position = pos,
            Queue = true,
        })
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level, enemy, pos, toss_ability)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
        return true
    end

    local grab = EnsureAbility(caster, TREE_GRAB_ABILITY, level or 1)
    if not grab then
        return false
    end
    local origin = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
    local forward = caster.GetForwardVector and caster:GetForwardVector() or nil
    local tree = CreateTempTreeNear(origin, forward)
    if not tree then
        return false
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(GRAB_CAST_DELAY, function()
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        if not grab or grab:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        if not tree or tree:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        GrabTree(caster, grab, tree)
        local checks = 0
        Timers:CreateTimer(GRAB_CHECK_INTERVAL, function()
            if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
                return nil
            end
            if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
                if toss_ability then
                    QueueTossTree(caster, toss_ability, enemy, pos)
                end
                return nil
            end
            checks = checks + 1
            if checks >= GRAB_MAX_CHECKS then
                return nil
            end
            return GRAB_CHECK_INTERVAL
        end)
        return nil
    end)

    return true
end

function TinyHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    EnsureState(context)
end

function TinyHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    return false
end

function TinyHandler:OnAbilityAdded(context, profile, ability)
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= TOSS_TREE_ABILITY then
        return
    end
    local caster = context and context.parent or nil
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local level = ability.GetLevel and ability:GetLevel() or 1
    EnsureAbility(caster, TREE_GRAB_ABILITY, level)
end

function TinyHandler:TakeoverCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster, ability, order_type)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= TOSS_TREE_ABILITY then
        return false
    end
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return true
    end
    if caster:HasModifier(TREE_GRAB_MODIFIER) then
        if profile.skill and profile.skill.SetHidden then
            profile.skill:SetHidden(false)
        end
        return false
    end

    local level = profile.skill and profile.skill.GetLevel and profile.skill:GetLevel() or 1
    EnsureTreeGrab(context, caster, level, enemy, pos, ability or profile.skill)
    return true, profile.interval or 0.5
end

return TinyHandler

**Assessing busy flag logic for clones and dummy units**

The busy flag is set on the caster (which may be a dummy or clone), but IsUnitBusy checks the parent, so clones marked busy might not reflect as busy on the parent, potentially allowing unintended actions. The busy check needs alignment to ensure all relevant units, including clones and dummies, correctly appear busy during Tiny's throw sequence.

**Clarifying busy flag handling and failure cases**

The busy flag should be set per casting unit, including clones and dummies, but setting it on the parent for clones may be excessive. Also, if tree creation fails in casting takeover, the busy flag must be cleared to avoid indefinite blocking, so I'll update takeover to clear busy on failure. The clone casting path calls ScheduleAfterCast regardless, which is acceptable since Tiny doesn’t use AfterCast.
